name: mine-start-grid
description: Gold mines and start locations on their building grid (64n). Input: the empty 64x64 map with two camera objects (1000, 300 and -2141, 675, distance 2000: the views the clicks are aimed in, chosen on the camera palette as we-drive's --look does), Player 1's start location at -2141, 675 and four gold mines off the grid (1000, 300 and others; loading and saving leaves them so). WE: the mine at 1000, 300 box-selected (from bare ground below it), number pad 6 and 8 (1088, 384); a start location from the palette at about -1900, 500 (moves Player 1's to -1920, 512), box-selected, number pad 8 (-1920, 576), Alt-dragged to about -2000, 900 (-1984, 896); a gold mine from Neutral Passive's palette at about 1030, -470 (1024, -448). Studio: the same by its selection keys and tools; placement.ts unitGridCells. Ignored: the start location's editor id, hit points and mana (the editor's palette makes it a new object, numbered last, with 0 and 0; Studio's moves the one there, which saves -1 and -1). The input is made by tests/fixtures/we-compare/make-mine-start-input.mjs. Expected MATCH

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const key = async (k, code) => { const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: k, code, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); }; await s.look.get('map/war3map.w3e.txt')(1000, 300, { id: 'ngol', x: 1000, y: 300 }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); await key('6', 'Numpad6'); await key('8', 'Numpad8'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.editors.saveAll();

const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); const key = async (k, code) => { const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: k, code, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); }; await key('Escape', 'Escape'); await s.look.get('map/war3map.w3e.txt')(-1920, 512, { id: 'sloc', x: -1920, y: 512 }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); await key('8', 'Numpad8'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.editors.saveAll();
